Add an Other Input Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to add an input type, such as Bonus or Overtime adjustment, that payroll officers can enter on a single payslip.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Other Input Types

Click Other Input Types.

4. New

Click New to create a record.

5. Name

Type the name, then press Tab.

6. Code

Type the code, then press Tab.

7. Save

Click the save icon to keep the record.

8. Saved

The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.
